result.summary: Tornquist Packaging AS shows a worsening payment pattern: settled invoices went from on-time/4 days late to 9 days late, and the oldest open invoice (INV002201, €34,433) is now 5 days past due. Two further invoices totaling ~€80k are due in the coming weeks, with exposure well within the single €210,000 credit line held by insurer CL05. Recommend monitoring closely for further slippage before any limit increase.
concerns: Increasing days-late trend across last three settled invoices (0 → 4 → 9 days)
Current open invoice already 5 days past due
Only one insurer (CL05) holds credit exposure, concentrating risk
Limited history (3 settled invoices) makes trend confidence moderate
